4. LOCK-IN
The Lessee shall not vacate the premises before the expiry of eighteen months. The Lessor may terminate this agreement at any time by giving fifteen days notice.

1. TERM
This agreement is for a period of twenty-four (24) months commencing on the first day of October. The parties agree that this agreement shall not be registered and shall be executed on plain paper.
heading: 1. TERM

5. ENTRY
The Lessor may enter the premises for inspection or repairs after giving the Lessee at least twenty-four hours prior written notice, at a time convenient to the Lessee, except in an emergency.
heading: 5. ENTRY

7. REPAIRS
All repairs to the premises, including structural repairs and repairs to the roof, walls and plumbing, shall be carried out by the Lessee at the Lessee's own cost.
heading: 7. REPAIRS

text:
2. SECURITY DEPOSIT
The Lessee shall pay a refundable security deposit equal to two (2) months rent. The deposit shall be refunded within one month of the Lessee vacating, less only the cost of damage beyond fair wear and tear, and the Lessor shall furnish an itemised account of any deduction.
heading: 2. SECURITY DEPOSIT

6. ENTRY
The Lessor or his agents may enter the premises at any time without prior notice to the Lessee for any purpose the Lessor considers necessary.
heading: 6. ENTRY

text:
7. TERMINATION
On the Lessee vacating, the Lessor shall refund the deposit as provided in clause 2. No part of the deposit shall be forfeited except against damage actually proved.
heading: 7. TERMINATION

6. REPAIRS
Structural repairs and repairs to the roof, walls and plumbing shall be carried out by the Lessor at the Lessor's cost. The Lessee shall be responsible only for damage caused by the Lessee.
heading: 6. REPAIRS

2. SECURITY DEPOSIT
The Lessee shall pay a refundable security deposit of six (6) months rent. The deposit shall be refunded subject to deductions at the sole discretion of the Lessor, and the Lessor shall not be required to furnish any account of such deductions.
heading: 2. SECURITY DEPOSIT

4. NOTICE TO VACATE
Either party may end this agreement by giving two (2) months written notice to the other. The notice period is the same for both parties.
heading: 4. NOTICE TO VACATE

5. NOTICE TO VACATE
The Lessee shall give three (3) months written notice before vacating. The Lessor may require the Lessee to vacate on fifteen (15) days notice.
